Hey Samir / Avery — happy to take this. Quick notes to prep and make the call actionable: 

1) Latency targets: 50ms p95 for ~64 tokens is aggressive but achievable with the right model variant + continuous batching disabled for that route (or tiny max batch size). We'll want to test with your real request/tokens distribution.
2) Throughput: 600 qps peak => we'll look at sharded dedicated pools and concurrent worker counts; also consider prefix/KV caching if you have repeat prompts.
3) Model: recommend trying Redwood-13B-8Q (quantized) for cost/latency balance; we can run a quick perf test during the demo.

Can you attach a sample request payload and a CSV of traffic across a typical hour? If procurement wants a standard NDA/POC contract, Lauren can share the intake doc.

I'll prepare a short perf checklist and the demo runbook.

—Ben
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
